name: CED Raleigh
old_description: We carry all the top manufacturers and brands in the business and we are anchored with our power switchgear line Schneider Electric and their lead brand – Square D!
about:
CED Raleigh operates from Raleigh, North Carolina, as a distributor of electrical products. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources. The business describes itself as carrying all the top manufacturers and brands in the industry.

The company stocks and distributes electrical equipment from major manufacturers, with a focus on Schneider Electric's Square D line of power switchgear. Its services include delivery and customer support, and it emphasizes a policy of service, integrity, and reliability. Facility size, headcount, and volume metrics are not specified.

CED Raleigh serves commercial markets, offering product solutions for commercial electrical projects. The company notes that services and solutions vary by market and branch location. Specific industry verticals or customer examples beyond the commercial sector are not detailed.

The company states a commitment to continuously improving access to its goods and services by individuals with disabilities. Its shipping and receiving departments are staffed by named personnel, though broader operational details are not provided.
